name: epic
description: Parent issue of a milestone or spec

name: factory-digest
description: The issue the daily digest is posted to

name: tier:medium
description: Merges automatically when the delta equals the approved plan

name: needs-human
description: Fix rounds exhausted, an escalation or a question; raises the tier to high

name: blocked
description: Cannot proceed; the reason is in a comment

name: size-accepted
description: HUMAN ONLY: accepts a pull request over the hard size limit

name: guard-change
description: HUMAN ONLY: accepts a change that weakens a guard

name: major-release
description: HUMAN ONLY: the planned merge of next into main

name: dependency-advisory
description: Open NuGet advisory found by the daily audit
